source: The comparison is useful precisely because it shows why ZXNAME0000XZ is not simply another head-sharing point. Its cache can occupy a size that does not correspond to any integer conventional KV-head count, because its stored object is a latent plus a positional component.
zh: 这种比较很有用，因为它说明了为什么 ZXNAME0000XZ 不仅仅是另一个头部共享点。它的缓存可以占用不对应于任何整数常规 KV-head 计数的大小，因为它存储的对象是潜在的加上位置组件。
